_about: Story registry for pipeline v3. Every story needs one entry. story_id is the permanent ID used throughout the pipeline -- never rename one. title must match the model stories doc ('Story N: <title>'). match: words that identify the story in a samples doc's file name (e.g. '孟母 samples with Teacher feedback.docx'). sample_id_prefix (optional): keeps the sample IDs used by the first pipeline (mengmu_samples#7), so results on the same samples can be compared with earlier pipelines; stories without it use <story_id>#<N>. Order matters: samples are listed in this order -- add new stories at the end.
